paper.title: Clipping Makes Distributed and Federated Asynchronous SGD Robust to Stragglers

claims.evidence: Constructive expectation-rate DAG passes the clipped-bias, virtual-iterate, descent, telescoping, norm-conversion, parameter, and complexity-inversion obligations.
claims.control: tau_max injection and wrong epsilon-exponent controls are rejected.
claims.boundary: Finite symbolic certificate, not a proof-assistant kernel artifact.

claims.evidence: The expectation DAG retains zeta through bias, moment, large-gradient, and complexity terms, then specializes to C1 at zeta=0.
claims.control: Heterogeneous and homogeneous specializations are checked with the same negative controls.
claims.boundary: Uniform scheduling and conditional-unbiasedness assumptions are explicit.

claims.paper_anchor: Theorems 4.3/5.2 and the broad first-result statement
claims.evidence: Cohen et al. 2021 supplies an earlier arbitrary-confidence asynchronous optimization result; the repaired local rate derivation still exposes an extra delta-dependent epsilon^-2 term.
claims.control: Expectation-only, runtime-only, serial, and later-prior controls are excluded from the novelty contradiction.
claims.boundary: Only the unrestricted novelty conjunct is falsified; the theta-dependent rate remains blocked.

claims.evidence: Initialized and trained real CIFAR/ResNet routes produce theta 0.0789 and 0.2246; exhaustive trained-route tail fractions peak at 0.2345.
claims.control: Known-theta estimator and reciprocal-convention controls pass.
claims.boundary: The authors’ checkpoint, preprocessing, reference gradient, sample count, and tail fraction are not identified.

claims.evidence: Under Vanilla ASGD, source values are CIFAR D4 1.8x, Shakespeare D4 1.8x, and Shakespeare D8 2.0x; D4 is below the imported Shakespeare 2.0–2.2x range.
claims.control: Corrected Vanilla range and Delay-adaptive comparator routes are retained.
claims.boundary: Comparator ambiguity prevents a comparator-free universal reading.

claims.evidence: Complete D4/D8 hyperparameter grids and independent three-seed validation are recorded; D4 speedup is 1.0227x and D8 has a censored clipped seed.
claims.control: Assumption-violating, historical-positive, and universal-positive controls distinguish blocked reconstruction from falsification.
claims.boundary: Exact CNN, sampler, seeds, queue/ties, cadence, aggregation, and author implementation remain unavailable.
